facts.text: Borgo Egnazia is in Savelletri di Fasano, where the hills of the Itria Valley fall away to the Adriatic Sea.
facts.excerpt: Borgo Egnazia is located in Savelletri di Fasano, where the hills of the Itria Valley gently fall away to the Adriatic Sea

facts.text: The property is inspired by the shapes, materials and colours of a typical Puglian village.
facts.excerpt: the property itself is inspired by the shapes, materials and colours of a typical Puglian village

facts.text: Homemade breakfasts are prepared by Puglian Massaie.
facts.excerpt: homemade breakfasts prepared by Puglian _Massaie_

facts.text: The spa is called Vair, described as the Puglian spa.
facts.excerpt: _Vair_, the poetic Puglian Spa

facts.text: The hotel has two private beaches, Cala Masciola and La Fonte.
facts.excerpt: two beautiful private beaches ( _Cala Masciola_ and _La Fonte_)

facts.text: San Domenico Golf is surrounded by ancient olive trees with views that stretch to the sea.
facts.excerpt: the scenic _San Domenico Golf_ surrounded by ancient olive trees with views that stretch to the sea

facts.text: A dedicated team called the Local Advisers is always available to guests.
facts.excerpt: a dedicated team always available to guests (the _Local Advisers_)
